patient_message.content: How early should I arrive, and which insurance plans do you accept?

assistant_message.content:
Thanks for reaching out! Here are the answers to your questions:

**Arrival time:** If this is your first visit to our clinic, please arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time to complete registration paperwork. Returning patients can arrive 5 to 10 minutes prior to their slot.

**Insurance:** We accept most major insurance providers, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, and Medicare. If you're unsure whether your specific plan is covered, just let me know and I can connect you with our front desk team, who can clarify your coverage.

Let me know if you have any other questions!
